descriptions.preferred: 'Baldsmith' is among the best of the newer dissectum introductions, bearing light, bright orange-red spring foliage. The leaves become paler and green-tinged in the center with pink-tinged margins as they develop. The combination of mature and new leaves through the summer gives a multicolored appearance of greens, pinks, and orange reds. In the fall, the leaves turn a bright yellow with orange hues. The medium-sized finely dissected fiveor seven-lobed leaves are 8-11 cm long and wide, the lower end narrowing to the width of the midrib for 1-1. 5 cm down to the junction of the lobes with the petiole. The division of the sublobes, unlike many dissectums, does not quite reach the midrib. The sublobes have conspicuous, large, narrow, sharply pointed teeth. sources.title: 巴尔德史密斯 Acer Palmatum 'Blad Smith'
sources.description: 它有着明亮而浅淡的橙红色新叶。 随着新叶 的成熟，叶片中部加深为灰绿色色调，叶缘 则呈现粉红色色调。 夏季新叶与老叶同时存 在，绿色、粉色、橙红色相互交错，呈现出 五彩斑斓的效果。 秋季叶片则是带着橙色色 调的亮黄色。 叶片呈细腻的羽毛状，具5-7裂， 叶片较大，裂叶下端变窄，几乎贴着裂叶中 脉。 小裂叶与其他羽毛枫不同，它没有完全 裂至叶片中脉。 小裂叶叶缘锯齿清晰，大而 狭长，叶尖锋利。 它树形与寻常的羽毛枫一 样，呈土丘状，抗性强，但是它有一个与众 不同的特点。 那就是它的裂叶独特、细腻， 叶色为浅橙红色，与绯红皇后的深红色叶片 非常不同。

rhs.description: A small, deciduous tree to around 3m in height, with feathery leaves which are orange to red as they emerge in the spring, turning to pinks and greens then finally a darker orange in the autumn

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Banks and Slopes, Patio/Container Plants, Rock Garden, Low Maintenance
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this dissectum group have fine, feathery, deeply divided leaves with finely serrated edges

care.cultivation: Grow in a moist but well-drained soil. Water in summer if necessary. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maple cultivation
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

care.cultivation: 宜栽培于湿润但排水良好的土壤中。夏季必要时应补充浇水。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳，但也可耐全日照。土壤水分不足或暴晒过度都可能导致叶缘焦枯。参见日本枫树栽培资料。

rhs_zh.description: 小型落叶乔木，高约 3 米。 叶片细裂如羽，春季萌发时呈橙至红色，随后转为粉色与绿色，秋季最终呈较深的橙色。
